business_tagline: Dawn paddles along the Cape coastline
hero_title: Paddle out at first light — we'll have the coffee ready.
hero_subtitle: Guided sea-kayak excursions along a working coastline, led by paddlers who know every swell of it.
directions: Launch from the public slipway at Hout Bay harbour, gate 3. Free parking on Harbour Road after 07:00.
what_to_bring: Swimwear, a warm layer for after, sun protection, and a reusable water bottle. We provide everything else.
what_to_wear: Quick-dry layers and closed shoes that can get wet. We supply wetsuits, spray-skirts and buoyancy aids.

tours.name: Dawn Patrol
tours.description: A quiet 90-minute paddle out before the wind picks up, tracing the kelp line past the seal colony while the light comes up over the bay.

tours.name: Cape Point Traverse
tours.description: A full-day open-water crossing for experienced paddlers, rounding the point with two guides and a support boat on standby.

tours.name: Sunset & Seals
tours.description: An easy family-friendly evening paddle through the harbour and out to the seal colony, back before dark with hot drinks waiting.

reviews.quote: We saw a pod of dolphins about twenty minutes in. The guides were relaxed but clearly knew exactly what they were doing.
reviews.author: Priya N.

reviews.quote: Cape Point Traverse was the hardest thing I've done on a holiday, in the best way. Worth every rand.
reviews.author: Marco D.
